#research · Ben Carter, Bill Stevens

[Mon 10/19 10:02] Ben: Starting the monthly asset manager note. Theme: third straight quarter of active outflows.
[Wed 10/21 13:20] Ben: TMC Q3 letter: AUM $38.4B, down 3%. Long/short funds bled, systematic funds grew.
[Wed 10/21 13:24] Bill Stevens: Cheap or cheap for a reason?
[Wed 10/21 13:31] Ben: 8.6x 2027 consensus vs 9–12x for alts peers. Cheap, but flows have to turn first.
[Thu 10/22 17:45] Ben: Fee compression is the other story: management fees down about 4 bps across the group.
[Fri 10/23 16:15] Ben: Note goes out Oct 30. Peer table refresh Monday.
